title: 自门控澄清：分层语言代理的智能求助机制
summary: 提出ACTION-RATING框架，将澄清行为嵌入代理的动作空间，与导航动作在同一序数尺度上竞争。在3万个节点的关税分类任务中，代理展现出强制性和机会性两种信息寻求模式，信息寻求有效性从50%提升至74%，准确率提升16.2%。
summary_en: Proposes ACTION-RATING, embedding clarification into the agent's action space on a shared ordinal scale with navigation. On a 30,000-node taxonomy task, agents exhibit mandatory and opportunistic information-seeking modes, with ISE rising from 50% to 74% and accuracy gains up to 16.2%.
